snippet.title: Exu tries to sleep, but anger won’t let him | Vem, Exu (Steam Trailer)
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist on Steam  
🎮 Try the demo  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4605020/Vem_Exu

Vem, Exu is an interactive story about anger, fantasy, and a lost kite.

After a fight with his brother, Exu tries to sleep,
but something begins to grow.

Exu’s anger doesn’t fade.  
It transforms.

Memory, imagination, and emotion start to blend,
and the world begins to change with what Exu feels.

This demo presents the first moments of Exu’s journey,
told mainly through interaction rather than text.

Also available on Android:  
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tejoestudio.exu
